svg.title: Escape Room Adventure | Manual save and load system

g.text: Escape Room Adventure | Manual save and load system
Require a current Game, then capture its immutable snapshot.
Both ACTIVE and ESCAPED games can be saved.
Call saves.save(snapshot); present success only after it returns.
No current Game or write failure -> explanatory output.
Saving never replaces or mutates the current Game.
Refresh feedback without reannouncing already-held items.
Loading is available before a Game exists, including the main menu.
Read snapshot -> load its template -> restore validated candidate.
Replace context ONLY after every restoration check succeeds.
Missing/corrupt/incompatible saves leave the old context intact.
Output uses fromNoGame if context is empty, otherwise fromGame.
Restore reuses saved values/questions without HTTP or new randomness.
Restore the linear successor structure from the matching template.
Template version changes whenever successors or appearance rules change;
incompatible template versions are rejected without migration.
Schema must equal 4; previous schemas are rejected without migration.
Validate every configured item/object and both gates in every room.
An unlocked ItemLock requires all configured IDs still in inventory.
A locked door with all IDs held is valid until explicitly unlocked.
Door unlocked AND exit Trivia passed is still the departure rule.
Either gate may already be passed independently of the other.
Every predecessor of the saved current room must have BOTH gates passed.
Current-room gates may remain incomplete in either order.
ESCAPED requires a current room with no successor and both gates passed.
Restore exact saved locations using the state constructor, never enterRoom.
Loading never acquires items or replays an obtained notification.
Capture EVERY room and EVERY configured item, including hidden items
and unvisited rooms. ItemState locations: ROOM / INVENTORY.
ROOM roomId matches its configured owner; INVENTORY has no roomId.
Held items are revealed and remain held after use.
Successful appearances transfer unique items automatically; already-held IDs
are skipped. Future initially-visible items stay ROOM until first entry.
ObjectState: values and completed one-shot action IDs.
LockState: exactly each room's door ItemLock and exit TriviaLock.
TriviaState: original prompt, choices and expected answer.
Save generated values, current room and ACTIVE/ESCAPED status.
TEMPLATE questions match the template resolved using saved values;
API questions keep their saved content. Answers never enter output.
Schema 4 keeps the same value shape; successors are immutable template data.
No duplicate inventory list, successor list, final-room or canLeave flag is saved.
No acquisition ledger or extra result/output field is introduced.
Restore never replays actions, requests API questions or calls RNG.
One configured manual save file; AppBuilder injects its Path.
Default: data/savegame.json, resolved from the launch directory.
Save replaces the same file only after writing and closing a
temporary file in the same directory and atomically replacing it.
On failure, retain the old save and clean up the temporary file.
Unsupported atomic replacement is a reported save failure.
use-case-owned DataAccessException. Path/JSON/IO stay in this layer.
Save and load have separate focused input interfaces and responsibilities.
AppBuilder injects the SAME save adapter and context into both interactors.
Serial CommandDispatcher orders gameplay, save and load; UI updates use EDT.
Every success/error/no-op refreshes output; only new transfers append obtained names.
This is a focused view; full application dependencies are in the application diagram.
